title: Experience Definition
description: Schema for concrete configured application experiences. JSON is the source of truth; ProjectDefinitionGenerator projects each record onto a cooked UProjectExperienceDefinition asset. Adding an experience is a data change only - no C++ class and no registration line.

ExperienceName.description: Stable experience identity. RENAME WARNING: referenced by the main-menu loadexperience action and by EntryPointExperience config. Mismatch causes a descriptor-not-found failure.

Map.description: Full object path of the world this experience travels to.

TraversalMode.description: Generic traversal policy token forwarded as the 'Traversal' load-request option. ProjectSinglePlay owns what the token means. Omit for the mode default.

AssetScanDirectory.description: Package directory scanned so cooked builds can resolve this experience's map. Omit when the map is already covered by project PrimaryAssetTypesToScan.

CriticalAssets.description: Assets that must resolve before the experience is loadable.

WarmupAssets.description: Assets warmed up alongside the experience.
